input_file.description: Path to the input OSM data file. If empty, reads from stdin.

output_file.description: Path to the output Navit binfile.

input_format.description: Format of input data: 'osm' for XML, 'pbf' for Protocol Buffer, 'o5m' for O5M.

compression_level.description: ZIP compression level for the output file (0=none, 9=best).

use_64bit.description: Enable ZIP 64 bit compression for large files.

slice_size.description: Limit memory for large internal buffers in bytes. Default 1GB.

index_size.description: Maximum country index size in bytes.

debug_level.description: Level to control which data is included in the debug attribute.

rule_file.description: Path to a mapping rule file. Empty string disables.

dedupe_ways.description: Ensure no duplicate ways or nodes.

keep_tmpfiles.description: Do not delete tmp files after processing.

ignore_unknown.description: Do not output ways and nodes with unknown type.

unknown_country.description: Add objects with unknown country to index.

dump_to_stdout.description: Dump map data to standard output in Navit textfile format.
